home.title: Turn a photo into an adorable acrylic cutie with a belly
home.sub: An acrylic figurine with your face and a soft belly that squishes right back. 11 cm, a built-in fridge magnet, the name printed on the figurine itself.
home.s1Body: Six ready poses: standing, with a beer, with a mug, hands in pockets, lying down. All the same price.
home.s2Body: AI cuts out the face alone. The kitchen behind you stays in the kitchen.
home.s3Body: We print it on the figurine itself, angled at the shoulder. You get 14 characters.
home.priceSub: Every figurine can be different — the discount counts the total.
home.q1A: Sharp, well lit, face pointing at the camera. The background does not matter — we remove it anyway, because only the face goes onto the figurine. Phone photos work great, best without filters. If the file is too small to print, the builder says so right away.
home.q2A: We print and dispatch within 48h. InPost adds 1–2 business days, courier 1 day. You see the exact date range above the builder before you order anything.
home.q3Q: What if I don’t like it?
home.q3A: Before production starts you get a preview to approve — we keep fixing until it is right. If the finished figurine disappoints you, we reprint or refund. You never ship it back.
home.q4A: InPost Paczkomat 12.99 zł, courier 15.99 zł. Free from 99 zł — that is already one L figurine or two S.
home.q5Q: Can I return a figurine with my face on it?
home.q5A: Personalized products are exempt from the standard right of withdrawal — nobody else will buy one with your face on it, and the law says so too. So we give you something stronger: you approve the design before printing, and on any quality defect we reprint or refund without a return parcel.
